results.note: Only third-party guides say entry is free. No official or ticketing page that I could open states a price, so I did not report it. The city page I tried returned an error.

The official MUHBA Plaça del Rei page lists a combined ticket at €7.30, with no separate single-site price. Other city guide pages list a €7 general ticket, so the figure is uncertain by €0.30. Santa Caterina is reportedly free, but I found that only on a third-party site.
The Barcelona city page lists 'General admission: €4.2'. Some other guides list €4.40. The museum is free on Sunday afternoons and on the first Sunday of each month, per secondary sources.
The Barcelona city page lists 'Entrada general: 8 €'. The reduced ticket is €6. A combined ticket with the Cathedral costs €15. The €6 general price on one external directory looks out of date.
